title: Historic Famines
text:
## Historic Famines

The following is a table of ‘Great Famines’, defined as those with an estimated death toll of 100,000 or more, between 1870 and 2024, along with a small number of well-known famines with a lower death toll. The list is regularly updated. Note: Mortality estimates marked * are minimum numbers, ongoing crises, or cases under ongoing active investiga tion. Mortality figures in brackets do not meet the threshold of 100,000 deaths. There are many additional famines of a scale lower than this threshold not included in the list.
